description: v4 only. Build an unsigned transaction to claim a wallet's V4 rewards. If 'ids' is omitted, claims everything currently claimable. Non-custodial. There is no v3 equivalent because a v3 claim needs no second call: get_user_rewards already returns the transaction.

chainId.description: Chain id to claim on. Required unless 'ids' is omitted, in which case the chain is discovered from the wallet's claimable rewards.

ids.description: Optional reward ids (from get_user_rewards). Omit to claim all claimable.

version.description: Optional, and only 'v4': this tool exists on v4 only.

name: prepare_claim_rewards
title: Prepare a rewards claim (V4)
